crossRefs.note: God worked special miracles by the hands of Paul,
so that even handkerchiefs or aprons were carried away from his body to the sick, and the diseases departed from them…
for she said within herself, “If I just touch his garment, I will be made well.”
and they begged him that they might just touch the fringe of his garment. As many as touched it were made whole.
Most certainly I tell you, he who believes in me, the works that I do, he will do also; and he will do greater works…

people.name: Peter
people.line: Apostle of Jesus, leader in the early church

translations.web: They even carried out the sick into the streets, and laid them on cots and mattresses, so that as Peter came by, at the least his shadow might overshadow some of them.
translations.bsb: As a result, people brought the sick into the streets and laid them on cots and mats, so that at least Peter’s shadow might fall on some of them as he passed by.
translations.kjv: Insomuch that they brought forth the sick into the streets, and laid them on beds and couches, that at the least the shadow of Peter passing by might overshadow some of them.
translations.asv: insomuch that they even carried out the sick into the streets, and laid them on beds and couches, that, as Peter came by, at the least his shadow might overshadow some one of them.
